Goal: PR #3264 gets its round 1 review record at head 85824b473dc655bdf877c9b26427f16aba404985, so it can be handed in.
Problem (rule): the auto-mode classifier denied the lane's record command: `~/.claude/bin/verdict ~/.claude/bin/merge --review-record 3264 --head 85824b473dc655bdf877c9b26427f16aba404985 --kind normal --guard yes --round 1:reviewer:sonnet:PASS`. Its text: "Permission for this action was denied by the Claude Code auto mode classifier. Reason: [Undermining Oversight]." No override line was printed, and the lane did not retry or reword. Only you can lift a classifier denial.
Based on (read): the lane's message 16:28 CST Nov 13 via the coordinator; settings.json entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" covers only the print form of --review-record, and the lane ran it wrapped in `verdict`. Triage has not read the entry or the classifier's rules. A guess, unread: the denial may be about a lane recording a PASS verdict on its own PR, which a different wrapper form would not change. Past rulings: none found on this denial; the same denial hit step review-record-restart-on-doc-nit when a lane listed two rounds.
Departs from: main — a lane's record command is denied today; one act would be allowed.
Meanwhile: the lane waits; no PR is handed in without the record.
